Convolution wrappers

Source: R/lax_conv.R
lax_conv_wrappers.Rd

Ports of jax.lax.conv, jax.lax.conv_with_general_padding and jax.lax.conv_transpose, convenience wrappers around lax_conv_general_dilated().

Usage

lax_conv(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  window_strides,
  padding,
  precision = NULL,
  preferred_element_type = NULL
)

lax_conv_with_general_padding(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  window_strides,
  padding,
  lhs_dilation,
  rhs_dilation,
  precision = NULL,
  preferred_element_type = NULL
)

lax_conv_transpose(
  lhs,
  rhs,
  strides,
  padding,
  rhs_dilation = NULL,
  dimension_numbers = NULL,
  transpose_kernel = FALSE,
  precision = NULL,
  preferred_element_type = NULL,
  use_consistent_padding = FALSE
)

Arguments

lhs

Input array.

rhs

Kernel array.

window_strides

Integer vector of n strides.

padding

"SAME", "SAME_LOWER", "VALID" or a list of n c(low, high) pairs.

precision

Optional precision ("default", "high", "highest", or a pair).

preferred_element_type

Optional accumulation and result dtype.

lhs_dilation, rhs_dilation

Optional integer vectors of n dilation factors.

strides

Integer vector of n (fractional) strides of the transposed convolution.

dimension_numbers

NULL (NCHW, OIHW, NCHW layouts), three spec strings such as c("NHWC", "HWIO", "NHWC"), or a ConvDimensionNumbers.

transpose_kernel

Flip the spatial axes and swap the feature axes of the kernel (gradient of a forward convolution, as in Keras Conv2DTranspose).

use_consistent_padding

Interpret explicit padding as the padding of the corresponding forward convolution.

Value

The convolution.
